The '''Hynestian Star Cruiser''' was a class of [[starship]] that fought against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] at the [[Battle of Exegol]] as a part of [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Citizens' Fleet]] in [[35 ABY]].

==Characteristics==
Sharing its name with the [[human]] [[Hynestian]] [[Subspecies|race]] from the [[planet]] [[Hynestia Prime|Hynestia]],<ref name="Lando's Luck">''[[Lando's Luck]]''</ref> the Hynestian [[Star Cruiser]] was a class of [[starship]]<ref name="Ships" /> that came into service by<ref name="TROS" /> [[35 ABY]].<ref name="35 ABY">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] to one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], which is in turn dated to [[34 ABY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. Thus, it could be found that the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' took place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> It was equipped with two [[engine]]s and six smaller engines at the rear of the vessel, with two at midship. It also featured a [[hyperdrive]] and two [[hangar]]s,<ref name="VF" /> and several of the ships fighting at the [[Battle of Exegol]] were also painted in [[color]]ed livery.<ref name="TROS" />

==History==
At the Battle of [[Exegol]] in [[35 ABY]],<ref name="35 ABY" /> large scores of Hynestian [[Star Cruiser]]s arrived at the [[Sith]] world as part of<ref name="TROS" /> a [[Citizens' Fleet]]<ref name="Lando DB" /> of volunteer civilians gathered by former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] and [[New Republic]] [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] from throughout [[the galaxy]] that took up arms to resist the [[Sith Eternal]]'s attempt at galactic domination. Hynestian Star [[Cruiser]]s were temporarily disabled above the embattled [[planet]] when the [[Immortality|resurrected]] [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious]], leader of the Sith Eternal, unleashed a torrent of [[Force lightning]] against the citizens' [[fleet]] during the battle, although the Sith were ultimately defeated shortly afterwards.<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Hynestian_Star_Cruisers.jpg|thumb|right|224px|Hynestian Star Cruisers first appeared in ''The Rise of Skywalker''.]]
The Hynestian Star Cruiser appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS" /> It was identified by a name that originated from the film production<ref name="Chee">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/1289288898913267712|[[Leland Chee]]|archivefile=:File:Hynestian MC95.png}}</ref> in the [[2020]] video "Every Ship in the Star Wars Sequel Trilogy," which was released by [[StarWarsKids.com]] as part of their ''[[Star Wars By the Numbers]]'' series.<ref name="Ships" />
